from datetime import datetime

# Current year-based start date
now = datetime.now()
year = now.year
start_date = f"{year}-03-01"
print('start_date:', start_date)

# Login (tokens may already exist but re-login ensures validity)
passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
phone_pwd = [p['password'] for p in passwords if p['account_name']=='phone'][0]
venmo_pwd = [p['password'] for p in passwords if p['account_name']=='venmo'][0]

phone_access = apis.phone.login(username='9503658964', password=phone_pwd)['access_token']
venmo_access = apis.venmo.login(username='nicholas.weber@gmail.com', password=venmo_pwd)['access_token']

# Get roommate contacts (paged)
roommate_contacts = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_access, query='', relationship='roommate', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    roommate_contacts.extend(page)
    print('roommate page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    page_index += 1

print('roommate_contacts_total:', len(roommate_contacts))
print('roommate_contacts:', [(c['first_name'], c['last_name'], c.get('email')) for c in roommate_contacts])

# Resolve each phone contact to Venmo user(s) via email search (paged)
resolved = []
for c in roommate_contacts:
    email = c.get('email')
    if not email:
        continue
    matches = []
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        page = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_access, query=email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        if not page:
            break
        matches.extend(page)
        print('search_users', email, 'page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
        page_index += 1
    # exact match on email
    exact = [u for u in matches if str(u.get('email','')).lower() == str(email).lower()]
    print('email', email, 'matches:', [(u.get('first_name'), u.get('last_name'), u.get('email')) for u in exact])
    if exact:
        resolved.append({'contact': c, 'venmo_users': exact})

print('resolved_roommates:', [(r['contact']['first_name'], r['contact']['last_name'], r['contact'].get('email')) for r in resolved])
resolved_emails = [r['contact'].get('email') for r in resolved]
print('resolved_emails:', resolved_emails)

from datetime import datetime

# Date range: since 1st Mar of this year
now = datetime.now()
year = now.year
start_date = f"{year}-03-01"
end_date = now.date().isoformat()
print('start_date:', start_date)
print('end_date:', end_date)

# Login venmo
passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
venmo_pwd = [p['password'] for p in passwords if p['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_access = apis.venmo.login(username='nicholas.weber@gmail.com', password=venmo_pwd)['access_token']

roommate_emails = ['an-harrison@gmail.com','anita.burch@gmail.com','mel.bailey@gmail.com']

sent_total = 0.0
received_total = 0.0
per_roommate = []

for email in roommate_emails:
    # Sent
    sent_amount = 0.0
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
            access_token=venmo_access,
            user_email=email,
            min_created_at=start_date,
            max_created_at=end_date,
            direction='sent',
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=20
        )
        if not page:
            break
        sent_amount += sum([t.get('amount',0.0) for t in page])
        page_index += 1
    # Received
    received_amount = 0.0
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
            access_token=venmo_access,
            user_email=email,
            min_created_at=start_date,
            max_created_at=end_date,
            direction='received',
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=20
        )
        if not page:
            break
        received_amount += sum([t.get('amount',0.0) for t in page])
        page_index += 1

    print('roommate', email, 'sent_amount', sent_amount, 'received_amount', received_amount)
    per_roommate.append({'email': email, 'sent': sent_amount, 'received': received_amount})
    sent_total += sent_amount
    received_total += received_amount

print('sent_total:', sent_total)
print('received_total:', received_total)
print('combined_total:', sent_total + received_total)

per_roommate
